items.Sentence: The proposed MFRO Facility would be sized to produce 2 MGD of MFRO product water
Tertiary treatment at HARRF consists of chemical coagulation and flocculation, DynaSand® monomedia continuous backwash upflow filtration, and disinfection using ultraviolet light and/or chlorination.
one 2-million gallon storage pond for secondary effluent and/or brine equalization storage

Secondary treatment at HARRF is accomplished by mechanically cleaned bar screens and aerated grit removal (cyclonic grit chambers), chemically-enhanced primary treatment (CEPT), aeration basins equipped with membrane fine-bubble diffusers, and secondary clarifiers.
Sludge from primary sedimentation is anaerobically digested and dewatered by centrifuge.
Waste activated sludge from the secondary clarifiers is thickened by dissolved air flotation, anaerobically digested, and dewatered by centrifuge.
Screenings from the headworks and solids from grit removal are collected on-site and trucked to a local landfill.
dewatered sludge is trucked to Yuma, Arizona and land applied
